name: Scaleflex VXP – DAM & Cloudimage
author: Scaleflex

sections.description:
Scaleflex VXP is a next-generation WordPress plugin that empowers websites to better manage and deliver their digital assets at scale. By combining Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Dynamic Media Optimization (Cloudimage) in a single, easy-to-use solution, Scaleflex VXP enables teams to streamline content workflows, reduce page load times, and deliver superior digital experiences.

  • Digital Asset Management (DAM): With DAM capabilities, Scaleflex VXP allows users to centralize their entire media library — images, videos, documents, and more — into an organized, searchable, and highly accessible system. Beyond simple storage, Scaleflex VXP excels at managing asset metadata, allowing users to efficiently track, tag, and enrich assets with custom metadata fields. This ensures better organization, faster retrieval, smarter search experiences, and full lifecycle control of digital assets. Teams can maintain brand consistency, collaborate seamlessly, and ensure that every asset carries complete contextual information.

  • Dynamic Media Optimization (Cloudimage): Cloudimage enhances website performance by automatically optimizing media files without compromising visual quality. Images and videos are dynamically resized, compressed, and delivered in next-gen formats like WebP and AVIF, tailored to the user’s device and network conditions. This leads to faster page loads, better SEO performance, improved Core Web Vitals scores, and enhanced user engagement.

Key Benefits:

  • Centralized asset management within the WordPress dashboard.

  • Comprehensive metadata management for better asset control and searchability.

  • Real-time image and video optimization for faster page loads.

  • Advanced search, tagging, and filtering capabilities.

  • CDN-powered media delivery ensuring global speed and reliability.

  • Seamless integration with existing WordPress media workflows.

  • Scalable for businesses of any size, from startups to large enterprises.

Whether you’re running an e-commerce platform, a digital publication, or a corporate website, Scaleflex VXP gives you the tools to manage, optimize, and deliver your media assets intelligently and efficiently — all while elevating your website’s performance.

How does it work?

Scaleflex VXP seamlessly integrates into your WordPress environment, offering two powerful solutions — Digital Asset Management (DAM) and Dynamic Media Optimization (Cloudimage) — within a single plugin.

However, you can only activate one mode at a time: either DAM or Cloudimage, depending on your specific needs.

This flexible setup ensures that you can tailor the plugin precisely to your content management or performance optimization strategy.

  1. Choose Your Mode: Scaleflex DAM or Cloudimage Mode

  • DAM Mode: Centralizes your digital assets, enriches them with detailed metadata, and crucially, delivers your assets via Scaleflex’s global CDN to accelerate media loading and improve website performance.

  • Cloudimage Mode: Focuses solely on optimizing your media files, dynamically compressing, resizing, and converting them into next-gen formats for the fastest possible load times.

  1. Connect and Operate in the Selected Mode

  • In DAM mode, Scaleflex VXP syncs your WordPress media to a cloud-based DAM system, manages rich metadata, and serves media assets through a high-speed, globally distributed CDN to ensure fast and reliable delivery.

  • In Cloudimage mode, Scaleflex VXP optimizes all uploaded or existing media for size, format, and delivery speed without additional asset management functionalities.

  1. Smart Delivery and Management
  • Whether managing assets with enriched metadata (DAM) or optimizing them for performance (Cloudimage), Scaleflex VXP ensures seamless operations — all within an intuitive, WordPress-native interface.

In short:

Scaleflex VXP gives you the freedom to either professionally manage, enrich, and deliver your digital assets through CDN (DAM) or boost website performance with automated media optimization (Cloudimage) — depending on what your project needs most.

If you have suggestions for new features, feel free to email us at hello@scaleflex.com

Scaleflex VXP is crafted by the Scaleflex team.

The plugin includes third-party libraries in minified form. Their full source code is publicly available and documented under the “External Libraries” section below.

External services

This plugin is a connector to Scaleflex VXP, a cloud-based Digital Asset Management and Optimization platform.

It requires an active token that communicates with Scaleflex’s infrastructure to manage and serve digital assets.

This service is provided by “Scaleflex”: terms of use, privacy policy.

Owned and Operated Domains

The following domains and subdomains are fully owned, operated, and maintained by Scaleflex, the developer and service provider of this plugin:

  • scaleflex.com – Official website, service overview, and documentation
  • filerobot.com – Core API and service endpoint for Filerobot Digital Asset Management
  • cloudimg.io – CDN infrastructure for media delivery and transformation
  • cdn.scaleflex.com – Script and static asset hosting for frontend components (e.g. filerobot-widget)
  • *.cloudimg.io, *.filerobot.com, *.scaleflex.com – All subdomains used for plugin features and integrations

All external resources loaded by this plugin — including image transformations, metadata management, and widget scripts — are delivered solely through these verified, Scaleflex-managed domains. No data is sent to or loaded from third-party services outside of Scaleflex infrastructure.

External Libraries

This plugin uses the following open-source JavaScript libraries:

  1. lazysizes

– Source: https://github.com/aFarkas/lazysizes
– License: MIT
– Description: High performance and SEO friendly lazy loader for images (official and maintained)

  1. js-cloudimage-responsive

– Source: https://github.com/scaleflex/js-cloudimage-responsive
– License: MIT
– Description: Client-side library to optimize and deliver images via the Cloudimage CDN

  1. chart.js

– Source: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
– License: MIT
– Description: Simple yet flexible JavaScript charting for designers & developers

  1. filerobot-widget

– Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@filerobot/readme
– License: MIT
– Description: The FMAW is a file uploader and media gallery in one easy-to-integrate modal or inline widget. It is the storefront of the Filerobot DAM (Digital Asset Management) and enables accelerated uploads through Filerobot’s content ingestion network and reverse CDN.

These libraries are included in their minified form for performance purposes only. Please refer to the respective repositories for the human-readable source code.
sections.installation:
Follow these steps to install the plugin on your WordPress site seamlessly:

  1. Navigate to the Install Plugins page in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. If you haven’t done so already, create an account on the Scaleflex website.
  3. Activate the Scaleflex VXP plugin within the Plugins page of your WordPress dashboard. Simply input your Scaleflex VXP token to complete the activation process.
sections.faq:
Why are my images not going through Scaleflex VXP?

If your images aren’t processing through Scaleflex VXP, check if you have cache services like W3 Total Cache, WP Super Cache, or others. If this is the case, you will need to reload the cache to enable the transformation of your URL.

If however the problem persists, please contact us directly at: hello@scaleflex.com

How much does Scaleflex VXP cost?

Scaleflex VXP is a SaaS that doesn’t offer a free tier for the time being. Depending on your needs, one of our representatives can present the best match for you in terms of plan and options included. You can request your quote here.

Will my original images be affected?

It depends on the storage option you choose during the setup:

  • If you select “DAM and WordPress” as your storage location, your original images will remain intact in your WordPress media library. No original files will be deleted or affected.

  • If you select “DAM Only”, all your original images will be transferred and stored in the DAM platform. They will be removed from your WordPress installation to ensure centralized management. Before choosing this option, we strongly recommend creating a full backup of your WordPress site to prevent any potential data loss.

In summary, your original images are safe if you opt for “DAM and WordPress,” but will be migrated to DAM and removed locally if you choose “DAM Only.”

What happens if I deactivate Scaleflex VXP plugin?

If you were to deactivate the Scaleflex VXP plugin, your website would revert to the condition it was in prior to the activation of the Scaleflex VXP WP plugin. We do not apply any permanent changes to your WordPress.

However, be mindful that any meta added to your pages after the activation of Scaleflex VXP will NOT be available after deactivation, which is why we strongly suggest to backup your WordPress before proceeding to the deactivation.
